art_5_1_c.title: Data Minimization
art_5_1_c.description: Personal data shall be adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary.

art_6_1_f.title: Legitimate Interest
art_6_1_f.description: Processing is necessary for legitimate interests pursued by the controller.

art_15.title: Right of Access
art_15.description: The data subject shall have the right to obtain confirmation of processing.

art_17.title: Right to Erasure
art_17.description: The data subject shall have the right to obtain erasure.

art_22.title: Automated Decision-Making
art_22.description: The data subject shall have the right not to be subject to automated decisions.

art_28.title: Processor Obligations
art_28.description: Processing by a processor shall be governed by a contract.

art_32.title: Security of Processing
art_32.description: Implement appropriate technical and organisational measures.

art_33.title: Breach Notification to Authority
art_33.description: Notify the supervisory authority within 72 hours.

art_5_1_e.title: Data Retention
art_5_1_e.description: Personal data shall be kept for no longer than is necessary for the purposes.

chapter_v.title: Cross-Border Transfers
chapter_v.description: Transfers of personal data to third countries require appropriate safeguards.
